LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 14.3.1 ADVERBS OF MANNER

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Manner
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Manner, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to clearly describe how something is done?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Manner together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is improved as they use adverbs of manner appropriately to

describe actions.

• Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to develop relationships is developed as they role play familiar situations using given verbs with peers and

describe the actions using adverbs of manner.

Values:
• Respect: A learner takes part in playing a language game with peers observing turn taking.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Life-skills (Self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is elevated as they improve their communication skills through use of adverbs of manner to

describe actions.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner links the concept of adverbs to learning of similar concept in Kiswahili Language Activities.
